name: Howling Vale
summary: The Terrowulf worgen howl through Howling Vale in north-central Ashenvale, near the Felwood border. Their caves hide an ancient shrine to Elune, bound to the worgen’s origins on Kalimdor.

sections.title: A Haunted Haven
sections.body: North of the road to Felwood, Ashenvale’s calm gives way to the howls of the Terrowulf. Ancient trees still fill the vale, but corrupted packlords and aggressive wildlife roam among them. A cave at its heart holds the shrine of Mel'Thandris, an ancient night elf priestess. Once a place of quiet devotion, the shrine now lies in ruins, defiled by feral wolf-men whose origin puzzles the nearby Sentinels.

sections.title: The Scythe and the Starsong Legacy
sections.body: The Tome of Mel'Thandris tells of recent events at the shrine. Night elf Velinde Starsong came into possession of the Scythe of Elune, a fateful artifact. She tried to channel its power against demons, but instead unleashed the worgen in the surrounding woods. The vale now echoes with the beasts she summoned.

faq.q: Why is it called the Howling Vale?
faq.answer: The Terrowulf worgen gave the vale its grim name with their chilling calls. Their constant howls echo through the canyon and cavern, drowning out Ashenvale’s natural sounds.

faq.q: What is the Shrine of Mel'Thandris?
faq.answer: The Shrine of Mel'Thandris is an ancient night elf sanctuary dedicated to Elune and named for Mel'Thandris. The Tome of Mel'Thandris kept there records events that may explain the wolf-men’s arrival.

faq.q: Where did the worgen here come from?
aliases: how did worgen get to ashenvale
faq.answer: The Sentinels are puzzled by the worgen’s origin. Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow sends Alliance scouts to study the Tome of Mel'Thandris at the shrine, where its history holds the key to where the wolf-men came from.

faq.q: What is the Tome of Mel'Thandris?
faq.answer: The Tome of Mel'Thandris is a sacred historical text kept at the shrine deep inside the cave. Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow sends Alliance scouts to study it and learn where the wolf-men plaguing the forest came from.

angles.text: For the kaldorei, the defilement of Mel'Thandris’s shrine is a bitter wound. A sacred place of Elune now lies overrun by savage wolf-men.
The feral wolf-men in the cave are a dark mirror of druidic shapeshifting. Their arrival in Ashenvale remains a mystery to the Sentinels.
